definitions.explanation: A practice examination that simulates the format and difficulty of an actual test, used to assess readiness and identify weak areas. Short for {模擬試験|もぎしけん}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{模試|もし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}している→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: I'm studying for next week's mock exam.

examples.japanese: {模試|もし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{志望校|しぼうこう}→志望校：18904_shiboukou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many people decide which school to apply to based on their mock exam results.

examples.japanese: ⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧{模試|もし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{偏差値|へんさち}→偏差値：08553_hensachi⟧60⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧だ。
examples.english: My goal is to score a deviation value of 60 on the nationwide mock exam.

notes:
FORMS:
{模試|もし} is the shortened form of ⟦{模擬試験|もぎしけん}→模擬試験：18219_mogishiken⟧. The full form is more formal, while {模試|もし} is the standard term in everyday student life.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {模試|もし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to take a mock exam)
- {模試|もし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧ (mock exam results)
- ⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧{模試|もし} (nationwide mock exam)
- {模試|もし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判定|はんてい}→判定：09767_hantei⟧ (mock exam assessment/rating)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Mock exams are a significant part of the Japanese entrance exam system (⟦{受験|じゅけん}→受験：04272_juken⟧). Companies like {河合塾|かわいじゅく} and {駿台|すんだい} offer large-scale {模試|もし} that rank students nationally using ⟦{偏差値|へんさち}→偏差値：08553_hensachi⟧ (deviation scores).

WATCH OUT:
Not to be confused with ⟦もし→もし：01284_moshi⟧ (if), which is a conjunction.
